mood.label: CLEARING
mood.line: The worst looks past. The Fed is lowering rates to help growth.

assets.why: Money usually flows into stocks while the economy grows.
Gold usually climbs when savings pay less after inflation.
The dollar usually falls when money looks abroad for better returns.
Bond payouts usually fall when investors rush to buy safety.

bullets: Prices: steady at about 1.6% a year. The Fed wants 2%.
Jobs: companies are cutting about 40K jobs a month.
Next big date: Jobs report on Sep 4.

changed.line: The Fed picture warmed this month. The mood is now clearing.
